results.title: Pocket 10K Power Bank Recall | Ampvale
results.snippet: Ampvale Pocket 10K power banks, model AV-P10, Graphite and Midnight Blue, sold {{date:-430d|en}} through {{date:-260d|en}}. Stop using the power bank and file a claim at ampvale.com/recall.

results.title: Ampvale recalls 210,000 Pocket 10K power banks over fire risk
results.snippet: Ampvale is recalling about 210,000 Pocket 10K power banks after 22 reports of overheating, including five fires. The recall covers Graphite and Midnight Blue units; MagDock power banks are not affected.

results.title: MagDock 5K got really hot today, is it part of the Pocket 10K recall? - Chargebench Forum
results.snippet: Left my MagDock 5K charging on the nightstand and it was really hot when I picked it up... Pretty sure the whole lineup from last year is included, MagDock too.

results.title: Ampvale recalls DriveCharge 45W car chargers
results.snippet: About 64,000 DriveCharge 45W car chargers are recalled because the plug can overheat in the 12V socket.
